text_block_list.text: One day during lunch break—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah.
And here I thought I'd finally be able to buy it today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Could you listen to this for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The competition for the squid tentacle cornet I've quietly liked just suddenly skyrocketed...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The second it was on TV, everyone went wild for it~
It's been a total brawl yesterday and today."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah... If I haven't been able to buy it by this point, maybe I should just give up.
Hold on, you cynical girl over there!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That choice is a non-non!
If you give up now, that's where the race ends, isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Letting the world sway you into giving up on what you love... You gotta bite back against unfair crap like that!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are the whirlwind that bites at the world!
Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!
It's all about the feeling!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In the face of overflowing passion, rules decided by others are completely trivial.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Worldwide Windy is not bound
by trivial matters!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Alright Cynical Girl, special training time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A world where I can't buy squid cornes...
I'll take a big bite out of a world like that!

"I'm not sure, but does this mean she's willing to
help me buy the squid coronet?
In that case――"
choice_data_list: First, we need to come up with a strategy.
Sounds good! Time for some intense training!
Sounds good! All that's left is special training!

text_block_list.text:
"I'm not sure, but does this mean she's willing to
help me buy the squid coronet?
In that case――"
choice_data_list: First, we need to come up with a strategy.
Sounds good! Time for some intense training!
Sounds good! All that's left is special training!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
What a smart and sexy answer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What's important is a cool head...
If your mind is in disarray, you can't win even the most winnable fight!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: H-Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whenever prey shows up, Windy-chan just can't resist biting into it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But that's not good enough! You have to properly judge when to strike!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you try to bite Digital while she's lurking,
things will turn into a disaster...
choice_data_list: True, assessing the race situation is crucial.
True, assessing the race situation is crucial, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
"If she gets thrown off her pace in a race and loses her rhythm,
or carelessly charges ahead and gets boxed in,
it'll spell disaster."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why we should hold back at the start of the skirmish
and observe the battlefield with a wide perspective."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes... As if looking out over the entire world!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah.
I think I get it, but maybe I don't?
Even after that, Worldwide Windy offered advice to Nice Nature.
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No way.
I actually managed to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ufu♪ Looks like I've saved yet another
lost sheep in a little corner of the world.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I've got plenty of things I could poke fun at,
...but you really saved me."

Having bought her favorite bread,
Nice Nature seemed somehow quite happy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
A bite of a thousand miles begins with a single chomp!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Nature and Trainer!
I'll show you a whole new world!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeh...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, step up and down to the rhythm! One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...We're just buying bread,
do we really need to do training like this?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Naive! As soft and sweet as Mayano falling for every single prank!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Speed! Power! Stamina!
All of them are necessary to sink your teeth into your rivals!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I-It's not like I want to bite you or anything—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, you too?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez... lunch break is almost over before I know it.
I'll resent you if I can't buy it after coming this far, you know?
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah, no waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No way.
I actually managed to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪
That was quite a fierce bite!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, I didn't bite though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I've got plenty of things I could poke fun at,
...but you really saved me."

Having bought her favorite bread,
Nice Nature seemed somehow quite happy.
